summary: Nightly: Method + Wowhead refetched, 0 of 160 letters moved; WoWMeta pushed 40 new values on a pinned date; SimC re-sim; 1 leak raid take; Archon walled day 35.

sources.detail: Attempted and Cloudflare-blocked from this runner. One bounded direct GET per registered page with the full browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + Accept-Encoding + sec-ch-ua + Sec-Fetch-*): HTTP 403 with the "Attention Required! | Cloudflare" interstitial on all six URLs (1,892-1,894 byte bodies; the raid-DPS page was also retried once at a larger 5,486-byte variant of the same interstitial). This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt (http 403, resolved: null, all six). No proxy, no challenge solve, no replay. Nothing parsed, so nothing written: snapshot stays 2026-09-27 (set by the 09-27 residential local run) and every page-stated published date is untouched. The stored 80 Icy Veins letters stand and keep feeding the consensus.

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET: HTTP 200, 163,420 B (raid) and 170,071 B (mplus) decoded. Era-verified from the BODY, not the meta tags: og/twitter/meta descriptions still carry the stale "The War Within Season 3" boilerplate (4 hits each) while the ranking body reads "Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" and "Midnight Season 2" for M+, and Devourer is present — body over title, so seasonVerified stays s2 on both pages; reading the og tag would have dropped Method out of both brackets' consensus. No page is a 12.1.5 preview (zero "12.1.5" hits on either). Parse: split on <div class="tier__tier", letter from the sibling tier__title, entries bounded to tier__entries and resolved from data-original-title looked up WHOLE against the roster — raid 40 (S 6 / A 11 / B 17 / C 6), mplus 40 (S 2 / A 13 / B 21 / C 4) = 80 rows, 27/7/6 per bracket, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates. The mplus page's four EXTRA tier blocks are the dungeon-difficulty list and were rejected by ROSTER MATCH, never by position (King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs). Page "Last Updated" lines re-read live: 10th August 2026 (raid), 13th August (mplus) — unchanged and matching both the registry and this run's published-evidence receipt, so published is untouched and only snapshot advances to 2026-09-29. 0 of 80 stored cells moved.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76,494-346,675 B decoded (no r.jina.ai — dead on /guide/*). Documented recipe: unescape \/ to / across the whole document FIRST, then take the [tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list] block (exactly ONE per page tonight, so no decoy printHtml to choose between), match [tier-label …]<TIER>[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace, resolve specs from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. Counts printed and reconciled against the roster shape BEFORE merging: raid DPS 27 (A 8 / B 14 / C 5), raid Healer 7 (S 1 / A 3 / B 3), raid Tank 6 (S 1 / A 3 / B 2), mplus DPS 27 (S 1 / A+ 2 / A 7 / B 14 / C 3), mplus Healer 7 (S 1 / A 3 / B 1 / C 2), mplus Tank 6 (S 1 / A 3 / B 2) = 80, 0 unmatched slugs, Devourer present in both DPS lists. 0 of 80 stored cells moved. Era: every h1/title reads "for Midnight Season 2"; the 3 "12.1.5" hits per page are the site's data-tree switcher (live tree 12.1.0, with a separate /ptr-2/ 12.1.5 URL) and the Season 1/Season 3 hits are retrospective prose and user comments — seasonVerified stays s2 on all six. JSON-LD dateModified re-read per page: raid 2026-08-31 x3, mplus DPS 2026-08-28, Healer 2026-09-10, Tank 2026-09-01 — all unchanged and all matching the stored published values and the pre-agent receipt, so only snapshot advances to 2026-09-29.

Not reachable: archon.gg is behind its Cloudflare wall for the 35th consecutive day. All six registered tier routes (dps/healer/tank raid Heroic all-bosses and dps/healer/tank mythic-plus/10/all-dungeons/this-week) were probed once each with the full browser header set: HTTP 403, <title>Just a moment...</title>, 3,435-3,508 byte bodies, and __NEXT_DATA__ ABSENT on every one — so neither the raid throughput tierList nor the M+ score tierList existed to read. Agrees with the pre-agent source-health receipt (raid route cloudflare-challenge at 403; M+ route human-verification at HTTP 200 — a 200 that is still a wall). No challenge solved, replayed or proxied. Per the owner-confirmed 2026-09-05 retention rule Archon's last verified S2 letters stay in the consensus at their own 2026-08-25 snapshot: an outage does not remove a source. No seasonVerified value changed anywhere this run, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to freeze (it is the publish job's step regardless).

Not reachable: archon.gg is behind its Cloudflare wall for the 35th consecutive day. The same wall covers every archon.gg route (see archon-tiers: 7 probes, all HTTP 403 "Just a moment...", no __NEXT_DATA__), so no per-boss or per-dungeon tierList could be read. data/encounter-tiers.json was READ, not written: it still stamps season "s1" at asOf 2026-08-17 with 9 raid + 8 mplus encounters and 619 tier rows, so the UI's Fight selector stays hidden and the S1 archive stays quarantined until an S2 Archon rebuild can actually be fetched. Committed encounter name values preserved untouched.

The registered aggregate route .../tier-list/dps-rankings/raid/mythic/all-bosses was among the 7 probed and returned HTTP 403 with the challenge body and no __NEXT_DATA__, so the survivability tierList was unreadable. Per the measured 2026-08-21 dead end, a per-boss page is NOT a substitute for the aggregate (2-of-9 boss coverage, the only complete set is a world boss, 55% of tiers disagree between the two populated bosses, 1-2 parse samples) and none was attempted. 40 stored survivability tiers retained exactly at 2026-08-25.

Not reachable: archon.gg is behind its Cloudflare wall for the 35th consecutive day. Nothing was fetched, so the mandatory pre-merge shape check (every value a plausible percentage, each role x bracket group summing to ~100, no row equal to that spec's 95th pct DPS) had no input and no merge was attempted — the failure mode that once published DPS magnitudes under unit % for three nights. 79 stored "Popularity" rows retained exactly at 2026-08-25.

Fetched successfully and the rankings file HAD moved, but the source's own snapshotDate has not, so the coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Two plain curl calls to the JSON API (never the HTML prerender, never r.jina.ai): manifest.json HTTP 200 with snapshotDate 2026-09-15, still pinned for a fifth week, and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 162,488 B, Last-Modified Tue 29 Sep 2026 10:03:08 GMT — the documented 2026-08-04 decoupling, where the manifest and rankings steps run independently. 44 blocks returned; selected by WHITELIST categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} PLUS sortField === "lowerBound" PLUS keyRange === undefined (never a mere "dungeon" blacklist, because melee/ranged are subsets of dps) = 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, classSpec names byte-identical to the roster with 0 unmatched. Merged lowerBound at the stored 1-decimal precision as "M+ lower-bound 95% CI rating (Blizzard API, population-wide)" with n = numberOfCharacters and asOf = manifest.snapshotDate (2026-09-15, NOT today). All 40 values moved; largest single move 5.28%, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6, so nothing was held back and no value_move_ack is needed. The published letters were deliberately not ingested (Ckmeans clusters of a player-count toggle) and the raid endpoint's lowerBound (DPS throughput) was not touched. The real staleness alarm is wowmeta's own maxAgeDays 8 in the contract, which the 09-15 date is now past — that heartbeat red is the honest signal.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent fetch-stable-metrics.mjs step, not by this agent, and merged ONLY through node src/apply-metrics.mjs metrics-fetch/updates.json — no second parser was written. Receipt: status success, all three meta pages HTTP 200 (71,302 / 42,299 / 40,903 B), 40 rows at roleCounts DPS 27 / Healer 7 / Tank 6, sourceAsOf 2026-09-29 with dateBasis source-time-datetime read from the pages' own <time datetime> stamps (2026-09-29T02:10:23-25Z), omittedSpecs none. All 40 rows merged as "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" — a top-50 ceiling, not popularity, and the "(ceiling)" stays in the name. node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs passes against the receipts and Git HEAD. Coverage date is today, so this is a genuine success.

Fetched fresh but upstream has not re-simmed, so the coverage date cannot advance. All 27 DPS specs requested from chart/get/talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 2 attempts each and a pause between: 24 charts returned, and the same THREE returned the 76-byte {"status":"error"} body on every attempt — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, the persistent-absence set since the 09-03 MID2 adoption and the same three SimC has no MID2 profile for. simc_settings.ptr compared EXPLICITLY against the string "0" (truthy in JS) on all 24; simc_settings.tier READ OFF each chart rather than assumed and MID2 on all 24, matching the stored pool, so the pool stays tier-uniform. Targets taken from data[MID2][<count>], already best-build, non-empty on all 24. asOf per chart from its own timestamp, never the run date: all 24 read 2026-09-23. The 12.1.5 wholesale-adoption hold does NOT fire: PHASES.livePatch and LABEL_FLIP_DUE are both null in src/normalize.mjs and this run's own evidence still has 12.1.5 PTR-only (Wowhead's data tree lists the live tree as 12.1.0 with a separate /ptr-2/ 12.1.5 URL; forum topic 2344395 is still titled "Midnight: 12.1.5 PTR Development Notes" with its newest staff post 2026-09-22), so current charts merge normally. Pre-merge diff: 0 of 24 profiles moved on any target count; the merge ran and left data/specs.json byte-identical. 24 profiles clears the 15 floor with no row drop. 6 days old against maxAgeDays 8, so no heartbeat red yet.

Fetched fresh; the report was re-run but the WoW build it sims did not move, so the source-owned coverage date cannot advance. reports/MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1,446,550 B decoded, and it HAD a "DPS Ranking:" block so the MID2_Raid.html fallback (and its burst/DTPS-chart inflation trap) was not needed. Era-verified off the HEADER build string, never a visible version number: "SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-09-24/69933, git build HEAD d08a1c38ef, no-networking)" — live 12.1.0, no 12.1.5. 46 ranking lines, the Raid aggregate row skipped, mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with hyphens allowed to 24 DPS specs at their best hero variant; the 7 unmapped names are all tank profiles (Prot Paladin/Warrior, Brewmaster, Vengeance, Blood x2) and correctly not ingested, and Balance/Augmentation/Devastation have no MID2 profile upstream, the same set Bloodmallet is missing. All 24 values moved; largest Unholy Death Knight 268,794 -> 272,675 = +1.44%, everything else smaller — ordinary re-sim jitter on an unchanged WoW build, nowhere near maxValueMovePct 0.6, so nothing was held back and no value_move_ack is needed. asOf = the report's own hotfix date 2026-09-24, so stored coverage stays 5 days old against maxAgeDays 10.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent fetch-stable-metrics.mjs step and merged ONLY through node src/apply-metrics.mjs metrics-fetch/updates.json. Receipt: status success, /period/latest HTTP 200 resolving to /period/1082 (the same period as 09-26/09-27/09-28, still updating mid-week), 185,361 B, 37 rows at roleCounts DPS 24 / Healer 7 / Tank 6. Shape checks in the receipt: role totals Ranged 27.1 / Melee 32.8 / Tank 20.1 / Healer 20.1 against the page's printed 27.2 / 32.9 / 20 / 20, whole-series sum 100.1 — the representation SHARE column, not the /meta per-key-presence figure. Three specs are absent from this period's chart (Devastation Evoker, Fire Mage, Affliction Warlock); the collector RETIRED exactly one of them, Warlock|Affliction, whose stored share was at or below MYTHICSTATS_RETIRE_MAX_SHARE (0.5pp), and apply-metrics removed that single row — 38 stored rows -> 37, a 2.6% drop, far inside maxRowDropPct 0.25 and clear of the 25-row floor. Devastation and Fire keep their existing stored rows and dates, since nothing may be carried into a period that did not print it and no fabricated zero was written. dateBasis observed-undated-source (the page publishes no update timestamp): changed/new observations take the fetch date, identical values keep their prior asOf, so coverage reads 2026-09-29. node src/check-stable-metrics.mjs passes against the receipts and Git HEAD.
